english.title: Park a motor vehicle in darkness other than at nearside of road
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the permission of a police officer in uniform, caused a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to stand on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), at a time between sunset and sunrise otherwise than with the nearside of the vehicle as close as may be to the edge of the carriageway .
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 101(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds - outside Greater London.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
